tests.code: const doc = document.documentElement.outerHTML; assert(/<!DOCTYPE html>/i.test(doc), "expected <!DOCTYPE html>");

tests.name: html lang=en
tests.code: assert(document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang') === 'en', "expected lang='en'");

tests.name: charset meta
tests.code: const m = document.querySelector('meta[charset]'); assert(m && /utf-8/i.test(m.getAttribute('charset')), "expected meta charset utf-8");

tests.name: title
tests.code: assert(document.title === 'My Page', "expected title 'My Page', got '" + document.title + "'");

tests.name: h1 Hello
tests.code:
const h1 = document.querySelector('h1'); assert(h1 && h1.textContent.trim() === 'Hello', "expected

Hello

");

hint.en: Order matters: DOCTYPE first, then <html lang>, then <head> (meta + title), then <body>.
hint.ru: Порядок важен: DOCTYPE первым, затем <html lang>, потом <head> (meta + title), потом <body>.

prompt.en: Build a form with id "contact": a text input with id "name" and a `<label for="name">` ("Name"), and an email input with id "email" and a matching label ("Email"). The form must have a submit button with `type="submit"` and text "Send". Every input must be reachable by its label.
prompt.ru: Сделай форму с id "contact": текстовый input с id "name" и `<label for="name">` ("Name"), и email-input с id "email" и подписью ("Email"). В форме — кнопка отправки `type="submit"` с текстом "Send". Каждый input должен быть привязан к своему label.

tests.name: form exists
tests.code: const form = document.querySelector('form#contact'); assert(form, "expected <form id=\"contact\">");

tests.name: label for name
tests.code: const form = document.querySelector('form#contact'); const inp = form.querySelector('input#name'); const lab = form.querySelector('label[for="name"]'); assert(inp && lab && lab.textContent.trim() === 'Name', "expected label[for=name] 'Name'");

tests.name: label for email
tests.code: const form = document.querySelector('form#contact'); const inp = form.querySelector('input#email'); const lab = form.querySelector('label[for="email"]'); assert(inp && inp.type === 'email' && lab && lab.textContent.trim() === 'Email', "expected email input + label 'Email'");

tests.name: submit button
tests.code: const form = document.querySelector('form#contact'); const btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"]'); assert(btn && /send/i.test(btn.textContent || btn.value || ''), "expected submit button 'Send'");

hint.en: `<label for="id">` binds the label to the input by id — clicking the label focuses the field.
hint.ru: `<label for="id">` привязывает подпись к полю по id — клик по подписи фокусирует поле.

solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Contact</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="contact">
    <label for="name">Name</label>
    <input id="name" type="text" />
    <label for="email">Email</label>
    <input id="email" type="email" />
    <button type="submit">Send</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

prompt.en: Build a signup form (id "signup"): an email input (id "email", `required`, `type="email"`, placeholder "you@example.com"), a password input (id "password", `type="password"`, `minlength="8"`), a checkbox (id "terms") with a label containing the text "Terms", and a submit button ("Sign up"). Native HTML validation only — no JavaScript.
prompt.ru: Сделай форму регистрации (id "signup"): email-input (id "email", `required`, `type="email"`, placeholder "you@example.com"), пароль (id "password", `type="password"`, `minlength="8"`), чекбокс (id "terms") с подписью «Terms» и кнопку отправки ("Sign up"). tests.name: email field
tests.code: const e = document.querySelector('#signup input#email'); assert(e && e.type === 'email' && e.required && e.placeholder === 'you@example.com', "check email input attributes");

tests.name: password field
tests.code: const p = document.querySelector('#signup input#password'); assert(p && p.type === 'password' && p.minLength === 8, "expected type=password minlength=8");

tests.code: const c = document.querySelector('#signup input#terms'); const l = document.querySelector('#signup label[for="terms"]'); assert(c && c.type === 'checkbox' && l && /terms/i.test(l.textContent), "expected checkbox + label 'Terms'");

tests.code: const s = document.querySelector('#signup button[type="submit"], #signup input[type="submit"]'); assert(s && /sign up/i.test(s.textContent || s.value || ''), "expected button 'Sign up'");

hint.en: The browser checks required/type/minlength automatically on submit — no JS needed.
hint.ru: Браузер сам проверяет required/type/minlength при отправке — JS не нужен.

solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Signup</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="signup">
    <label for="email">Email</label>
    <input id="email" type="email" required placeholder="you@example.com" />
    <label for="password">Password</label>
    <input id="password" type="password" minlength="8" />
    <label for="terms">Accept Terms</label>
    <input id="terms" type="checkbox" />
    <button type="submit">Sign up</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
